meta.name: Search game prices and deals with Discord and IsThereAnyDeal

parameters.content:
## Discord Game Search Command

### How it works

1. The webhook receives Discord commands and a parsing node extracts the command and arguments.
2. A router node dispatches the command to one of three branches (lookup, deals, or help).
3. The lookup branch searches ITAD for a game, finds the best match, fetches price details, loads stored history, and builds a lookup reply.
4. The deals branch queries ITAD for deals and builds a deals reply.
5. Built replies (lookup, deals, or help) are sent back to Discord by the Discord reply node.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the Discord Message Webhook with the correct webhook URL or set up the Discord credentials in the Discord node.
- [ ] Add the ITAD API key (isthereanydeal) into HTTP Request credentials or environment variables used by the ITAD request nodes.
- [ ] Ensure the data table node (Load Stored History) is initialized and has the correct table name/schema accessible to the workflow.
- [ ] Verify the Parse Command and custom code nodes have any required environment variables or secret values available in n8n.

### Customization

Adjust command names and parsing logic in the Parse Command node, modify outgoing message templates in the Build Reply nodes, and change how history is stored/queried by updating the data table node.

## Receive and parse command

Webhook trigger receives the Discord message; parsing code extracts the command and arguments and the switch node routes the request to the appropriate branch.

## Search and build lookup

Handles the lookup flow: search ITAD for games, extract the best match, request detailed prices, load stored history, and build the lookup reply.

## Fetch and build deals

Queries ITAD for current deals and formats the deals reply to be sent back to Discord.

## Build and send replies

Builds the help reply (for help commands) and sends all built replies to Discord via the Discord node.
